docs.summary: Plugin is available only inside the editor and never shipped in a build.
Managed plugins only: whether user assemblies reference it automatically.
When true the plugin applies to every player platform.
Explicit player platforms (only consulted when [`AnyPlatform`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Projects.Scripting.PluginInfo~AnyPlatform) is false).
Whether this plugin should be shipped when building for the given player platform.
docs.remarks: "Any platform" is taken literally for a managed assembly and not for a native one, because a native library's extension already states which platform it is for. Without that, a .dll left at the default ships inside every Linux and macOS build.
